title: Abel-Type Transformations and Telescoping Structures in Reciprocal Series of Second-Order Linear Recurrences
summary: We develop a unified method for transforming and evaluating infinite series involving products of terms of second-order linear recurrences in the denominator. The approach is based on a discrete Abel-type summation formula (summation by parts), which converts reciprocal series with three or more factors into expressions exhibiting a partial telescoping structure. As a consequence, we obtain general transformation formulas for series of the form $\sum\limits_{k=1}^{\infty} \frac{(\pm 1)^k}{w_{rk+l} w_{mk+s} w_{m(k+1)+s}}$, together with extensions to products of four or more terms.
